description: This file defines FastAPI router endpoints for the Connector Backend API. It includes endpoints for authentication (API key and OAuth), connector registry (listing and upserting connectors), business operations (search, create, list projects, list spaces), and an LLM proxy. It relies on various models, utilities, and services to manage connectors, tenants, tokens, and external API interactions. The file mainly wires FastAPI routes with logic to handle request validation, calling provider services, and responses.

methods.name: ConnectorResponse connector_to_response(c: Connector)
methods.description: Converts a Connector model instance to a ConnectorResponse schema.

methods.name: auth_api_key( body: ApiKeyAuthRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )

methods.name: list_connectors(ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Retrieve all registered connectors for the tenant.

methods.name: create( body: CreateRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: Create an item in a provider, e.g., Jira issue.

methods.name: list_projects( connector_key: str, user_id: str, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: List projects for a given connector that supports it.

methods.name: list_spaces( connector_key: str, user_id: str, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), _auth=Depends(require_authenticated_connector), )
methods.description: List spaces for a given connector that supports it.

methods.name: llm_proxy(request: Request, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context))
methods.description: Forward request payloads to the configured LLM service.

methods.name: ProviderServiceBase _get_service_for_op( connector_key: str, ctx: TenantContext, token_repo: UserTokenRepo )
methods.description: Helper to retrieve the provider service instance for an operation.
